overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole conducted final public interviews for the position of City Clerk and voted to recommend Laurel Siegel for the appointment.

items.title: Resolution 25149: City Clerk Recruitment and Interview Process
items.summary: Councilor Callahan outlined the state-mandated public interview process consisting of four standard questions and councilor follow-ups for the two finalists.

items.title: Candidate Interview: Kevin Foley
items.summary: Kevin Foley discussed his background as a former city solicitor and elected official, emphasizing the need for organized records and a proactive approach to public service at the clerk's counter.

items.title: Candidate Interview: Laurel Siegel
items.summary: Laurel Siegel highlighted her experience as the city's CDBG manager and a longtime attorney, focusing on resolving the ordinance backlog and improving digital accessibility for city records.

items.title: Deliberation and Recommendation for City Clerk Appointment
items.summary: Approved a motion to recommend Laurel Siegel for the position of City Clerk and proceed with an employment offer following a straw poll of council members.

items.title: Recognition of Acting City Clerk
items.summary: Council members formally thanked Acting Clerk Rich Eliseo for his ten months of service managing the office during the vacancy.
